Neuroscience Engine: temporal binding, arousal, prediction error, reconsolidation, context retrieval, hippocampal replay, cognitive chunking, schema assimilation, interference forgetting. 107 new tests, post-encode hooks, paginated tag fetch.

v4.14→v4.20.2: 8 releases, 52 MCP tools, ~5173 tests.

Highlights:
- Fidelity Layers — memories decay FULL→SUMMARY→ESSENCE→GHOST with budget-aware compression
- Ephemeral Memories — ephemeral=true for auto-expiring scratch notes
- Consolidation Timeout — per-strategy (120s) + total (600s) timeout, no more hour-long runs
- Dream/Enrichment O(N²) caps for large brains (5K+ neurons)
- Write Gate — configurable quality filter before storage
- Dead Neuron Pruning — auto-prune unused neurons during consolidation
- Vietnamese Capture Quality — dramatically reduced low-quality Vietnamese memories
- Merkle Delta Sync — efficient cloud sync with hash-based change detection
- Brain Quality Engine — domain entities, structured data encoding, cross-encoder reranking
- Ctrl+K Command Palette — dashboard-wide search
- Input Firewall — blocks garbage/adversarial content from auto-capture
- Consolidation Lock — prevents concurrent corruption
- Agent Identity Capture — per-agent filtering in multi-agent setups
- Keyword Recall Optimization — 4-phase algorithmic enhancement
- Adaptive Instructions — self-improving procedural memory with success tracking
- 10 optimized agent instruction surfaces
